message.reasoning:
I'm in a strong position with $769 cash and need to decide whether to build more houses to finish faster. I have reds at 4 houses each and greens at 2 houses each, so upgrading the greens would be more threatening, but that would cost $1200 total and I'm short on cash. I'm considering whether to unmortgage a property to free up funds or just build strategically with what I have.

My opponents are essentially eliminated—Grok has nothing, GPT has $277, Gemini has $56—so there's no real threat to my position. The rents are already lethal. I could build 3 houses for $600, leaving me with $169 as a buffer, which feels safe given the situation. Building evenly on all three greens to bring them from 2 to 3 houses each would increase the pressure significantly and help me close out the game faster.
